context: Add regression tests for parser equivalence, generator identity/closure, multi-shard and Parquet streaming, exact row counts, dry-run semantics, and failure propagation before changing production code. Then implement the shared delimited/Parquet streaming path in ClickHouseNativeHandler and pass per-execute driver settings for insert_block_size, integer-byte max_memory_usage, and max_execution_time=0. Keep local/chDB and non-server bulk behavior unchanged.
description: Implement the ClickHouse server-mode host-local data loader as one real Python GeneratorType per table, with the pinned clickhouse-driver performing bounded transport blocks. Preserve parser and type-conversion semantics, close generators explicitly, propagate typed load failures, and make server-mode dry runs explicit. The runtime path must never instantiate RowBatchProcessor, use range(..., 1000), delegate to super().load_table_bulk(), or retry a failed stream through the legacy path. This item owns the loader and driver contract only; resource-rung selection and UAT certification are downstream gates.

anti_patterns.dont: Keep super().load_table_bulk() as a server-mode fallback
anti_patterns.instead: Raise a typed ClickHouse load error and stop.
anti_patterns.why: It re-enters the legacy per-shard loader and recreates the 1,000-row path

anti_patterns.dont: Materialize SF1 tables with pq.read_table() or a full Python row list
anti_patterns.instead: Use ParquetFile.iter_batches() and a bounded generator.
anti_patterns.why: Peak client memory becomes part of the failure

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a zero row count after an exception as success
anti_patterns.instead: Propagate the typed error through both DataLoader entry points.
anti_patterns.why: The benchmark could continue against an empty or partial table

preserves.behavior: A streaming insert failure is terminal for the table and must never retry through 1,000-row application batches.
Do not change ClickHouse local/chDB file() loading.
Do not change non-server dry-run placeholder behavior in unrelated handlers.
Do not change the global RowBatchProcessor default or semantics for other platforms.
The native driver must receive an actual Python GeneratorType, not merely an arbitrary iterable.
